description: This Java class defines a Spring configuration component that sets up OpenAPI metadata for the API documentation. It specifies API info, contact details, tags, and external documentation link using Swagger/OpenAPI libraries for API documentation purposes.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up OpenAPI documentation metadata for the To-Do Notes API.

methods.name: todoNotesOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with API info, contact, tags, and external docs for Swagger UI integration.
